description: This file contains core type definitions, protocols, and interfaces used throughout the Dynamo system in PyTorch, including guard management, frame and cache types, callback and hook protocols, and utility functions.

classes.name: GuardFail
classes.description: NamedTuple representing a failed guard with reason and original code.

classes.name: GuardFilterEntry
classes.description: Dataclass representing a guard filter entry with various guard attributes.

classes.name: GuardFn
classes.description: Protocol defining the interface for guard functions, including attributes and call method.

classes.name: GuardedCode
classes.description: Dataclass encapsulating code, guard manager, compile ID, and trace annotation.

classes.name: ConvertFrameReturn
classes.description: Dataclass representing the return value for frame conversion, including execution strategy and guarded code.

classes.name: DynamoCallbackFn
classes.description: Protocol for callback functions used during frame evaluation.

classes.name: DynamoGuardCompleteHook
classes.description: Protocol for guard completion hook functions.

classes.name: ProfilerStartHook
classes.description: Protocol for profiler start hook functions.

classes.name: ProfilerEndHook
classes.description: Protocol for profiler end hook functions.

classes.name: BytecodeHook
classes.description: Protocol for bytecode transformation hook functions.

methods.name: wrap_guarded_code
methods.description: Utility function to create a ConvertFrameReturn object with default execution strategy and guarded code.
